role: Describe the reader in one sentence: their function, and the decisions they actually make.
focusAreas: An area where this reader can act, stated concretely enough to change how an implication is written
A second area — three to six is the useful range
Name the sub-domain, not the industry: 'PPA offtake risk' beats 'energy'
readingIntent: What the reader wants from the brief. Example: understand what changed well enough to raise it in a meeting or act on it this week.
notes: Anything that changes register: languages read, assumed background, what not to explain.
